Title: Senior Data Engineer
Description: Your Team Responsibilities The Senior Data Engineer will work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, engaging with investment and technology professionals both within MSCI and across external organizations. The team is responsible for establishing and maintaining data feeds with custodian banks and data vendors, developing scalable data integration solutions, and supporting business growth through automation and process optimization. Senior Data Engineers are expected to demonstrate strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a proactive, entrepreneurial mindset. Successful candidates will be comfortable working independently and collaboratively, managing multiple priorities, and leveraging emerging technologies to continuously improve data workflows and operational efficiency. Your Key Responsibilities Establish and maintain data feeds with custodian banks, data vendors, and other third-party service providers to support reliable integration of investment data. Strong proficiency in SQL and Python, with hands-on experience in data processing, analysis, and workflow automation. Solid understanding of data modeling, data quality, and database concepts, with the ability to work with large and complex datasets. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to independently investigate issues and develop effective solutions. Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and adapt to evolving business and technical requirements. Familiarity with modern AI tools and experience leveraging AI-assisted development to improve efficiency, automation, and productivity. Eagerness to learn new technologies, explore innovative solutions, and continuously improve existing processes. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Finance, or a related field. Experience with Snowflake, Databricks, Apache Airflow, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP) is a plus. Master's degree in a relevant discipline preferred. Knowledge of financial markets is preferred. CFA charterholders or candidates pursuing the CFA designation are a plus. Title: ANALISTA COMERCIAL
Description: Objetivo del Puesto Asegurar la generación, análisis y seguimiento de información comercial clave para optimizar la toma de decisiones, impulsando el crecimiento de ventas, la rentabilidad y la eficiencia operativa de los talleres. Este rol contribuye directamente a los objetivos estratégicos mediante el monitoreo constante de indicadores críticos (venta, margen, catálogo, inventario y abastecimiento), la detección proactiva de oportunidades o riesgos, y la ejecución de acciones que garanticen la disponibilidad de producto y el mejor desempeño comercial del catálogo. Responsabilidades Principales Análisis de Indicadores (KPIs): Monitorear y reportar métricas de venta, margen de utilidad y rotación de inventarios para identificar desviaciones. Optimización de Catálogo: Evaluar el desempeño de los productos actuales y proponer ajustes para mejorar la oferta comercial. Gestión de Abastecimiento: Colaborar con los talleres para asegurar que los niveles de inventario sean óptimos, evitando quiebres de stock o excesos. Eficiencia Operativa: Detectar cuellos de botella en la operación comercial y proponer soluciones que maximicen la rentabilidad. Toma de Decisiones Basada en Datos: Traducir datos complejos en recomendaciones accionables para los líderes de área. Competencias Técnicas Capacidad de Análisis y Juicio: Habilidad para interpretar grandes volúmenes de datos y transformarlos en insights estratégicos. Mentalidad Innovadora: Apertura para proponer nuevas formas de trabajo y mejorar los procesos actuales. Agilidad de Aprendizaje: Capacidad para asimilar rápidamente nuevas herramientas tecnológicas y dinámicas del mercado e-commerce.

Title: LATAM Corporates - Consumer & Retail, Associate Director (Monterrey)
Description: LATAM Corporates – Consumer & Retail, Associate Director (Monterrey) Fitch is seeking an Associate Director for coverage of the Consumer & Retail sector based out of our Monterrey office. As one of the world’s top three credit ratings agencies, Fitch Ratings plays a critical role in global capital markets by providing supplementary credit analysis, ratings, research, and commentary to financial market participants. For over 100 years, Fitch Ratings has been creating value for global markets through its rigorous analysis and deep expertise, which have resulted in a variety of market leading tools, methodologies, indices, research, and analytical products. Fitch Ratings is part of Fitch Group, a global leader in financial information services with operations in more than 30 countries, which also includes Fitch Solutions. With dual headquarters in London and New York, Fitch Group is owned by Hearst. Joining Fitch Ratings in LATAM offers the opportunity to work with the most celebrated credit ratings organization in the region, renowned for its excellence and leadership. We boast a track record of over four decades of experience, with more than 2,000 ratings assigned to Latin American banks, corporates, structured finance, sovereigns and other entities. We cover the most relevant capital markets, showing a deep-rooted understanding of the region's unique financial environment. Our team is committed to innovation and collaboration, providing a dynamic environment where you can make a difference. Learn More: https://careers.fitch.group/go/Ratings-LATAM/9772901/ Qualitative credentials will weigh meaningfully in the selection of the candidate. A healthy sense of intellectual curiosity is critical, along with a willingness and ability to attack and explain topics of analytical complexity. Fitch is a team-oriented work environment, so excellent communication skills are essential, as is a high productivity work-ethic and results oriented mindset. What We Offer An opportunity to be a lead coverage analyst in the LATAM Consumer & Retail team at a global rating agency. A team-oriented work environment. Fitch Ratings is a global company with a presence in over 30 countries, offering opportunities to work with diverse teams and clients from around the world. We’ll Count On You To Perform analysis of key quantitative and qualitative factors influencing the credit quality of companies in the LATAM Consumer & Retail team. Develop and maintain comprehensive financial models. Present analysis of companies to internal credit rating committees. Conduct meetings with LATAM Consumer & Retail industry management teams. Involvement in communicating rating rationale to external audiences (primarily institutional investors, sell-side analysts and media) in meetings, conference calls, press releases and written research reports. Write timely and effective research on topical issues. Participate in the evaluation of other credits within the Consumer & Retail team, as well as other related credit groups. Represent Fitch in panel discussions and conferences arranged by industry associations, regulatory bodies etc. Mentor junior members of the LATAM Consumer & Retail team. Participate in meetings with Consumer & Retail industry executive-level management teams to strengthen understanding of their business and industry. What You Need To Have Bachelor's degree at minimum, MBA or other advanced degree a plus; 5+ years of relevant experience, which must include some coverage or knowledge of the Retail & Consumer sectors; Capital markets and/or credit analysis experience a plus; Strong analytical, quantitative, and organizational skills; Excellent written and verbal communication skills; Ability to shift fluidly between multiple projects as priorities change; Ability to excel in a team-oriented environment; Advanced English proficiency (verbal and written); Native Spanish speaker or advanced Spanish proficiency (verbal and written); Expertise in Excel and Word; CFA candidate preferred, CFA/CPA a plus. What Would Make You Stand Out A deep understanding of and a keen interest in the Consumer, Food & Beverage, Agriculture, Protein and Retail sectors; A professional background in capital markets and/or credit analysis and well-developed financial statement analysis and modeling skills; A strong pattern of leadership and the ability to proactively and successfully interact with various stakeholders, both within and outside of the organization. Intelligent solutions are increasingly part of our day-to-day operations, helping teams work more efficiently and think differently as we continue to evolve. We’re looking for colleagues who are comfortable operating in an AI-enabled environment—or who are curious, adaptable, and eager to build their AI literacy over time. We value professionals who embrace technology as part of continuous learning and who are committed to using it thoughtfully to enhance how work gets done. Fitch is committed to providing global securities markets with objective, timely, independent and forward-looking credit opinions. To protect Fitch’s credibility and reputation, our employees must take every precaution to avoid conflicts of interest or any appearance of a conflict of interest. Should you be successful in the recruitment process at Fitch Ratings you will be asked to declare any securities holdings and other potential conflicts prior to commencing employment.
